读后续写：阅读下面材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。（2025·新课标 I 卷）
My wife and I wanted to share our new home with family and friends by hosting a small gathering in the early summer. She had prepared lots of snacks, while my job was to have the backyard in order.
There was plenty of space for the kids to run and play. There was just one thing I hadn't counted on: My brother chose to bring his dog Toby, a 50-pound ball of fire. Though friendly, he could easily knock over my niece's small boys and my six-month-old granddaughter. So, when my brother showed up, I asked him to watch Toby and keep him outside.
My plan was working out just fine. Toby was using up his energy by running back and forth in the backyard and giving the kids plenty of room. Unexpectedly, after supper, the weather changed. It started to rain and everyone went indoors.
It was an awkward moment. I didn't want Toby to be running around in the house, and my brother wasn't happy with driving home with a wet dog. Eventually, my brother decided to leave rather than force the issue.
A few days passed, and I hadn't heard anything from my brother. I texted him and expressed wishes for him to come out again. His reply came as a surprise—a shock, actually: "Not a chance." Clearly, he was unhappy over the way we had parted. After all, I had left him little choice. Well, he'll get over it, I reasoned.
Two months passed. My wife suggested I get in touch with my brother, but I resisted, thinking he should call first. However, my conscience kept bothering me. I tried to put myself in my brother's shoes. He was facing health issues and his wife of thirty-five years had passed away a few months earlier. Toby was his constant companion, the one who kept him going.

I realized it was me who was at fault. I had been so focused on protecting the kids that I overlooked my brother's feelings. He was struggling with health problems and the recent loss of his wife, and Toby was more than a pet—he was family, a source of comfort. By keeping Toby out, I had unintentionally made my brother feel unwelcome. The more I thought about it, the more I understood that his hurt reaction came from a deeper place. It was my pride that had kept us apart for two months. Now, I knew I had to apologize face to face, not just with words but with genuine understanding.

With the biscuits my wife had made, I arrived at my brother's door. He opened it with a guarded look, but I didn't wait for him to speak. "I'm sorry," I said, meeting his eyes. "I was wrong to treat Toby like an inconvenience, especially when you needed him most." I handed him the warm biscuits. For a moment he was silent; then a faint smile appeared. He stepped aside, and Toby came bounding out, tail wagging. My brother said, "He remembers you." That broke the ice. We talked—really talked—and I listened. By the time I left, a new understanding had grown between us, stronger than before.

I realized it was me who was at fault. When my brother's bothered face emerged in my mind, my heart broke and my hands kept trembling. I told my wife that I wanted her to make some gifts for him and I decided to apologize to my brother face to face. My wife agreed and soon gave me a box of hand-made biscuits.

With the biscuits my wife had made, I arrived at my brother's door. With tears in my eyes and my voice shaking, I said sorry and explained that I hadn't kept Toby in mind at that time, and how regretful and awkward I was, and wished him to accept my apology. Much to my surprise, he returned a warm smile without a second thought, welcoming me to enter his home. Playing with Toby, I realized that every life, even a dog, should be taken as a real family member.

你写的版本在情节完整性和情感表达上做得不错，已经包含了“反思—准备道歉—行动—和解—感悟”这样一条清晰的线索，并且能够选择“手抖”“含泪”等细节来渲染情绪，这些都是值得肯定的。

但仔细推敲，还有一些可以打磨的地方：

1. **句子结构略显松散**。例如第一段中“I told my wife that I wanted her to make some gifts for him and I decided to apologize to my brother face to face”是两个并列动作，用and连接，节奏平淡，而且“wanted her to make”有些绕，不如直接用asked my wife to make。  
2. **道歉时的表述有些堆积**。“I said sorry and explained that I hadn't kept Toby in mind at that time, and how regretful and awkward I was, and wished him to accept my apology”连续使用and列出多个内容，缺少层次感。可以拆成复合句或有伴随状语，使道歉更有力度。  
3. **兄弟的反应略显突然**。“returned a warm smile without a second thought”与之前两个月冷战、说“Not a chance”的态度反差太大，缺少一个中间状态（比如他先沉默，或听到某句话才松动），会让人觉得转折不够自然。  
4. **结尾感悟稍显直白**。“I realized that every life, even a dog, should be taken as a real family member”的道理本身没错，但表达得像喊口号，如果能通过某个动作或画面自然而然地流露，会更符合“读后续写”所要求的含蓄升华。

**升格版本**

I realized it was me who was at fault. Whenever I pictured my brother's bothered face, my heart ached and my hands couldn't stop trembling. I told my wife immediately that I needed to apologize in person and asked her to make some biscuits for him. She agreed without hesitation, and soon a box of homemade biscuits was ready in my hands.

With the biscuits my wife had made, I arrived at my brother's door. My eyes were wet and my voice shook as I said, “I’m so sorry. I was so focused on the kids that I forgot about Toby—and about you. I regret how things turned out. Please forgive me.” To my surprise, he didn’t turn me away. Instead, he stood silent for a moment, then a gentle smile spread across his face. “Come in,” he said softly. Once inside, I played with Toby, and it struck me that he was indeed a part of my brother’s family. From that day on, I learned to look beyond my own concerns and truly care for those I love.
